newsitem.title: UK: Pizza Hut signs Pamela Anderson for European ads.
newsitem.headline: Pizza Hut signs Pamela Anderson for European ads.

text.p: Pizza Hut, the U.S. based restaurant chain, on Tuesday said it signed "Baywatch" television star and sex symbol Pamela Anderson Lee to do a television commercial to be broadcast in Britain and throughout Europe.

"We worked hard with our European colleagues to find someone who appealed to everyone in Europe but we feel sure that no one is bigger than Pam, especially in the UK," Gary Haigh, marketing director for Pizza Hut UK, said.
The ad will initially be broadcast in Britain next February before unfolding across Europe.
Pizza Hut declined to detail how much it will pay the 29-year-old actress for her appearance in the 30- to 40-second commercial.
Pizza Hut said the ad will be gently humorous -- along the lines of a recent Pizza Hut ad in which supermodel Linda Evangelista's hair changed colour.

Pizza Hut has been running a series of humorous ads in Britain featuring celebrities. British footballers Stuart Pearce, Gareth Southgate and Chris Waddle -- who have all missed vital penalities in matches against Germany -- were recently signed to appear together in a commercial for the restaurant chain. British Grand Prix driver Damon Hill and television sports commentator Murray Walker have also appeared together in a Pizza Hut advert.

"We are thrilled to have made this significant signing and believe that people will find this commercial as funny as all the others," Haigh said of Anderson Lee. "We certainly aim to show that there's more to Pammy than meets the eye."
Anderson Lee, who has appeared on the cover of Playboy a record six times, is married to Tommy Lee, the drummer from rock band Motley Crue.
Pizza Hut in the UK is jointly owned by U.S.-based PepsiCo, developer of the pizza chain, and Whitbread, the British brewing and leisure group.
